title: Pane Tree Structure and Invariants
description: Description of the tree representation and mutation rules.
body: The pane tree — how surfaces are arranged inside one cluster. A cluster's layout is a tree with interior nodes (splits) and leaf nodes (panes). Two invariants hold: No empty leaves except the root, and No split with fewer than two children and no split directly inside a split of the same direction. Nothing here knows about Tauri or windows — the operations easy to get subtly wrong (remove a tab, collapse the split it emptied, keep size weights aligned) are pure functions over a plain tree, tested as such.
